P1.source: Read Section4.3/p.7, Figure4/p.8, C.6-C.8 pp.21-22, README timing command, complete relevant layer_benchmark paths and later whole-model benchmark/REALQUANT qualifications. Rechecked the two official specification sources read-only.
P1.independent_argument: The active layer benchmark extracts model.layers[0], deletes the model, builds n_layers=1 cache and calls that layer for prefill/decode/run_e2e. Under the report explicit dense FP16 full-resident assumptions, bytes=2*32*64*S*32*128*2; dividing by2^30 yields64GiB at2048 and72GiB at2304, versus2.25GiB for one layer at2304. Official RTX3090 memory is24GB.
P1.alternative_and_dependency: A later benchmark_model.py does call the full model. REALQUANT lines91-92 points to bfd9e88/older transformer version for original-like speeds and lines147-155 documents later additions. Microbatching, offload, shared prefixes or layer extrapolation change the protocol. These unresolved alternatives prevent a proved historical full-model failure or fabrication verdict. Table20 is explicitly single-layer and is not criticized as hidden.
P1.severity_and_repair: Needs Evidence retained. Request exact historical commit/command, resident-layer/cache/batching policy and raw timings, or relabel as layer/extrapolated timing. Accuracy and transform algebra do not depend on the missing historical speedup provenance.

scope.source: Read source Eq.(2)-(3) transformation discussion p.4 and static flat_utils/trans_utils paths; compared active report limitations.
scope.independent_argument: Index expansion of row-major vec(V)(A tensor B) gives entry(i,j)=sum_ab A_ai V_ab B_bj=(A^T V B)_ij. Weight path W P^-T then yields XP(WP^-T)^T=XW^T. For orthogonal U,V and nonzero D, (UDV^T)^-T=UD^-1V^T, agreeing with code. This is exact pre-quantization algebra, not a post-rounding kernel proof.
scope.alternative_and_dependency: No full GPU/kernel or historical benchmark is tested. The flatness scale observation is valid for positive scaling of nonnegative channel statistics; the report unqualified absolute-value scaling identity was narrowed to c>0, since it is not true for arbitrary negative c. This does not change its .1 example or assessment.
scope.severity_and_repair: Bounded No Issue Found algebra survives; no general statement that any invertible transform is a single Kronecker product is accepted. Other experimental/conditioning limitations remain as explicitly stated.
